notes.title: Cross Promo: Femboy Futa House Launch
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45103276/2a2e94fa2ffbd6086da255385f85ae9047a0ccc4.png[/img]

[b]My friends at Tophouse just released their new game, Femboy Futa House, on Steam![/b]

[b]Give it a try and support a cool group of devs making femboy games![/b]

[b]Story Overview:[/b]

Living at the College of Magical Arts won't be easy, but your power will help you ✨ After you fail your entrance exams, they send you to dorm 9 ¾ — home to the strangest and most extraordinary students on campus. But on your first night, something happens that changes everything: it turns out you have a rare gift — an Amplifier, the ability to amplify other people's magic. Now your life will be a whirlwind of attention, temptation and danger.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/

notes.title: My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend! Store Page Open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231408/6992d73a3c74345293b831ef5506f74f74cd65ca.png[/img]

In this sequel to My Femboy Roommate, you take your roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary.

Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and growing closer to Robin. Lounge by the pool, indulge in the amenities, and make new connections—all while preparing something unforgettable to close off your weekend with Robin.

How will you spend your special weekend with Robin?

notes.title: Haunted by Femboy Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231408/5c126d7a899162b79f3f1052f5ab2dcbd546deb8.png[/img]

[b]After many months, it's finally ready.[/b]

The demo for Haunted by Femboy has been released on Steam now! Please play the demo and wishlist the game if you enjoy it and want to stay tuned for the full release!

The demo is 20,000+ words long, featuring over 2600 words of professionally voice-acted dialogue and fully animated NSFW scenes! For a full list of features, check out the store page!

In Haunted by Femboy, you unexpectedly inherit a mysterious mansion from your estranged father. While exploring your new home, you discover an ancient cursed book called the "Bussy-Nomicon" and accidentally summon Quinn - a flirtatious ghost femboy who's been trapped in the book for a millennium. Now bound together for life, can you uncover the secrets of your father's mansion while dealing with your spooky new companion?
